weather.text:
The wind turns in the afternoon. It is not a storm, but the boat starts to work at the water instead of over it, and a water jar gets loose and is caught by a boy who has done this before.

The master shouts something that is half Akkadian and half weather.

choices.text: Keep out of the crew's way.

after.text: By dark the wind has gone around and the sea is merely tired. Nobody thanks you, and nobody tells you to stop, and the boat goes on.

choices.text: Sleep when it is your turn.
